learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected75% against64%,86%,94% chance of spam ranking above real mail, ties half; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Checked first spam row:5/25 pairs,5 wins. Check all pairs:25 checked,21.5 wins. Screenshot shows three full winning rows;0.5 loses to0.6;0.3 loses to0.6 and0.4,ties0.3,wins0.2/0.1. Clicking next row after completion left state unchanged.
observations.reveal: Corrected86%,computed21.5/25 and half-credit tie. Named AUC and cutoff-free pair comparison. No ROC curve itself drawn.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshots inspected. Labeled5×5 matrix uses ticks,crosses andhalf symbol. Counts and full reveal readable.

prediction.reason: Precise percentage choice mainly tests substantial pair bookkeeping before exploration.
